result.summary: Found 2 visually noticeable issues: one image appears stuck in a loading state, and the bottom navigation bar is covering part of the content below.

issues.description: The ramen restaurant image has a loading spinner visible in the center, making the card look unfinished or stuck loading.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the image loads correctly or replace the spinner with a proper skeleton/loading state until the image is ready.

issues.description: The next restaurant card at the bottom of the screen is partially obscured by the fixed bottom navigation bar, cutting off content.
issues.suggestion: Add enough bottom padding/margin to the scroll area so the last visible card can scroll fully above the navigation bar.
